title: SCP Scorecard Opt-In Registry
description: List of adopter repositories that have opted in to cross-repo scorecard aggregation per WP-SCP-023 023C / D-042. Adopters PR additions; CODEOWNERS-protected via `docs/scorecards/** @jrnb2024`. Each entry pins the SCP reusable workflow path + SHA the adopter's caller wrapper invokes — this is the `--signer-workflow` argument the aggregator passes to `gh attestation verify`. A verification mismatch (adopter bumped wrapper SHA pin without updating registry) is a `verification_failure` row in the index, NOT silent acceptance.

schema_version.description: Registry schema version. Aggregator drops registries with unknown schema_version.

adopters.description: List of opted-in adopter repos. Order is canonical (sorted by `repo`).

default_branch.description: Default branch the aggregator queries for the latest green policy-check run.

expected_scp_workflow_ref.description: The SCP reusable workflow path + SHA pin the adopter's caller wrapper currently invokes — passed verbatim to `gh attestation verify --signer-workflow`. Must include the @<sha> suffix. When the adopter bumps the SHA pin, this entry MUST be updated in the same PR (or a sibling PR landed before the next aggregator run).

opted_in_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the adopter row was added. Optional; informational only.

notes.description: Optional free-text note. NOT propagated to the index.
